I am working in the Netherlands and would like to request you to kindly guide me for following question. I along with some of family members would like to start a student welfare fund from Zakat money. Where we are planning to collect our zakat money in a separate account and give to different deserving students (orphans etc.) for higher studies. But this will be a soft loan without any interest, service charges or time limitations. When candidate will start job, he has to return with 10 % of his salary. This returning money will be used for further students. In this case once money is gone from our pocket as for zakat, it will never come back but will be in circle for deserving students. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 60128 Country: India Title: Zakat on PF and Gratuity Question: I am working in a private firm on monthly salary. (1) Is zakah valid on Provident Fund when we have not withdrawn that and also don't have any intention now to withdraw. The amount is getting accumulated in my PF account. Though we can withdraw some partial amount as per government rules. And we can withdraw full amount when we leave this company. (2) Is zakah valid on gratuity amount? A servant gets some money as gratuity if he has completed more than 5 years in a company and now is leaving the company. I have completed more than 5 years and also looking for a new job. I will get this money only when I resign from this company. Answer ID: 60128 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1135/1155/L=09/1436) (1) Zakah is not wajib on PF amount right now. When you withdraw this amount after you are retired from your employment then zakah shall be wajib on it as per the condition of zakah. (2) This amount also carries the same ruling as of PF and no zakah is wajib on it right now. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
